Project Announcement & Technical Preview (v0.4.3) • Universal x64 & ARM64

RaggieSoft Installer Studio — Install Without Limits.

An original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 Windows packaging suite for x64 and ARM64. Design projects visually inside a 12-View Tree-First IDE—with dedicated Features and RegEdit-style Registry trees, 5 guided AeroWizards, Dual C++ & MSI.DLL Dialog Designers, and a built-in C++ F1 Help Viewer—and ship one universal Setup.exe that automatically detects your user's processor.

28 Years in the Making (1998–2026) • Why I Built This

From Visual Basic 6.0 in 1998 to Zero-Bloat Win32 C++20

Ever since I started learning Visual Basic 6.0 back in 1998, I spent 28 years searching for the right Windows installation tool—shipping software across more than a dozen packaging engines spanning every era of Windows deployment: the limited-edition setup wizard bundled in the Visual Studio 6.0 box, classic procedural script installers, 3D-beveled commercial suites, interactive CD-ROM multimedia autorun builders (yes, at one point I even tried bending an autorun menu builder into an application installer!), lightweight open-source script packagers, and heavyweight enterprise MSI and XML toolchains.

Every Windows installer ultimately marshals calls down into the exact same msi.dll and cabinet.dll libraries Microsoft already ships inside C:\Windows\System32. Yet every tool I tried forced a painful tradeoff between multi-gigabyte IDE bloat, 32-bit legacy debt, opaque binary project files, steep XML boilerplate, or broken Windows 11 Dark Mode and screen-reader accessibility.

RaggieSoft Installer Studio takes everything those eras got right—plain-text diffable manifests, authentic relational .msi compliance, hierarchical tree editors, single-file LZMS solid compression, and classic-to-modern wizard ergonomics—and rebuilds it from first principles as original, MIT-licensed native Win32 C++20 software for x64 and ARM64.

Shipping Today in Technical Preview (v0.4.3)

  • Single-Download CPU-Aware Web & Offline Universal Installers: Users never have to guess whether they own an AMD64 (x64) or ARM64 PC—ship one compact Smart Web Stub (IsWow64Process2 + WinHTTP + SHA-256) or one Combined Offline Universal EXE bundling both architectures
  • 12-View Tree-First Win32 C++20 IDE (InstallerStudio.exe): Categorized sidebar, dedicated Features tree (Move Up/Down), RegEdit-style Registry tree (.REG import + Feature filter), Dual Folder trees, and 5 guided AeroWizards—with Community == 100% Premier parity
  • 100% Dark-Mode-Complete UI + Live OS Theme Hot-Swapping: Custom-subclassed push buttons, checkboxes, 32-bit ARGB vector tree icons, and RichEdit panels that flip live on WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet)
  • Native C++20 Help System, MSI SelectionTree, Pre-MSI Runtimes & msiprism.exe: Zero-dependency RaggieSoftHelp.exe, 32-bit ARGB feature tree, unlimited [Prerequisite.*] runtimes, 64-bit .MSM merging, and --emit-ai-spec / --emit-vpat

Focused Path to v1.0.0 GA (Dogfood North Star)

  • v0.5.0 — 8 Wizard Styles & WCAG-Guarded Branding: Wizard95, Wizard97, AeroWizard, FluentMica, OneClickSplash, PassiveToast, FullScreenBlue (with billboards & docked 3D gauge), and Autorun16x9 + live WCAG 2.2 AA contrast enforcer
  • v0.6.0 — Granular .rswpak On-Demand Feature Packs + .NET 11 + Engine = native: Stream optional multi-gigabyte feature packs on demand, curated .NET 11 presets, and zero-msi.dll transactional extraction
  • v0.7.0 & v0.8.0 — From-Scratch Dialog Builders, RsDialog Scripting & VB6 .vbp / .slnx Importers: Blank-canvas C++ & raw MSI.DLL dialog designers plus Reg-Free COM VB6 .vbp importing for classic utilities like StoreTrainer
  • v0.9.0 & v1.0.0 GA — Signing Studio, White-Label RsUpdate.exe & Full Production Cutover: Azure Artifact Signing, guided .MSP servicing, and packaging 100% of RaggieSoft's own software

Core Engineering Design Principles

The "Zero-Bloat" Architecture Matrix

Technical Architecture Goals for RaggieSoft Installer Studio
Design Pillar RaggieSoft Installer Studio Why It Matters
Toolchain Footprint Compact static /MT binaries (InstallerStudio.exe, instbuild.exe, SetupWizard.exe, msiprism.exe & RaggieSoftHelp.exe) Instant cold startup on local developer workstations and CI runners without multi-gigabyte framework installs.
Runtime Dependencies Zero third-party DLLs (System32\msi.dll, cabinet.dll, gdiplus.dll & Msftedit.dll only) Even the offline F1 Help Viewer runs natively in C++20 on stock Windows 11 (x64 & ARM64) with zero .NET or WebView2 requirements.
Tree-First Visual IDE 12 Views + 20 32-Bit ARGB Vector Tree Icons Dedicated Features, RegEdit Registry, Dual Folder, Runtimes, and Shortcuts trees with DarkMode_Explorer chevrons.
Windows Installer Rules ICE18, ICE38, ICE64 & ICE80 Enforced Validates Single-Directory Component rules, HKCU user-profile KeyPaths, CreateFolder, and 64-bit component attributes before msi.dll runs.
White-Label & Parity Community == Premier + 100% Author-Owned VERSIONINFO Community Edition enjoys full Premier feature parity, and compiled Setup.exe / .msi files carry your publisher identity with zero watermarks.
AI Agent Native --emit-ai-spec + --diagnostics=json Coding agents read deterministic /llms-full.txt and SKILL.md specs to write, lint, and compile installers from scratch.
Five Native Binaries in One Cohesive Toolkit

Suite Spotlight: IDE, CLI Compiler, Setup Wizard, MSI Prism & Help Viewer

InstallerStudio.exe — 12-View Tree-First IDE

Features a 4-category sidebar tree, dedicated Features and RegEdit Registry trees (with .REG import), Dual Folder & Contents trees, 5 guided Win32 AeroWizards, Dual Dialog Designers, and a 100% comment-preserving .rsip AST!

Explore IDE Screenshots

instbuild.exe — Headless CI & AI Spec Compiler

Sub-millisecond --validate --diagnostics=json linting, automated --emit-vpat WCAG 2.2 AA conformance reports, and built-in --emit-ai-spec generation (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, SKILL.md) emitted directly from the C++20 constexpr grammar.

View Complete /llms-full.txt

msiprism.exe & RaggieSoftHelp.exe

Inspect relational SQL tables grouped across 5 schema categories in 64-bit Dark Mode with MSI Prism, and browse searchable offline HTML5 documentation in under 5ms via Named Pipe F1 IPC inside RaggieSoft Help Viewer.
